Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Presence of malignancy
  -  Pregnancy  [OR] or lactation
  -  Clinically significant diseases
  -  History of drug  [OR] or alcohol abuse
  -  Allergy to pantoprazole  [OR] or to any component of regimens used in the study
  -  Use of anti-secretory drugs, [OR]  antibiotics  [OR] or probiotics 4 weeks preceding the enrollment
